> Doesn't the new NRA cover this? Because it is on a card in play [her
> own], Blanche can only use her untap ability once per turn, so she can
> hunt, untap and hunt, but she can't untap AGAIN after that.

The "new NRA" only covers special ability *actions*. Blanche's
special ability is not an action.

But her card text explicitly limits the special to "once per turn", so
the question of "does the NRA limit it to once per turn" is superfluous.
